mapper.update: INSERT INTO access_stat_monthly (stat_month, site_id, total_visits, unique_visitors, page_views, avg_response_ms, error_count, top_pages, top_referrers, top_browsers) SELECT #{statMonth}, #{siteId}, COALESCE(SUM(total_visits), 0) AS total_visits, COALESCE(SUM(unique_visitors), 0) AS unique_visitors, COALESCE(SUM(page_views), 0) AS page_views, COALESCE(AVG(avg_response_ms)::int, 0) AS avg_response_ms, COALESCE(SUM(error_count), 0) AS error_count, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb FROM access_stat_daily WHERE TO_CHAR(stat_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{statMonth} AND site_id = #{siteId} ON CONFLICT (stat_month, site_id) DO UPDATE SET total_visits = EXCLUDED.total_visits, unique_visitors = EXCLUDED.unique_visitors, page_views = EXCLUDED.page_views, avg_response_ms = EXCLUDED.avg_response_ms, error_count = EXCLUDED.error_count
mapper.select: SELECT stat_month, site_id, total_visits, unique_visitors, page_views, avg_response_ms, error_count FROM access_stat_monthly WHERE stat_month = #{statMonth} AND site_id = #{siteId}

SELECT page_url, COUNT(*) AS visit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM access_log WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND created_at >= NOW() - (#{days} || ' days')::INTERVAL GROUP BY page_url ORDER BY visit_count DESC LIMIT 10
